core.label: Core Rig & Bodies
core.description: Canonical 53-joint Quaternius UAL1 rig, 89 CC0 clips (UAL1 + UAL2 + KayKit 2H Rifle), and stylized faceted parametric base bodies, heads, and hair.

medieval.label: Medieval Kingdom
medieval.description: Plate armor, tunics, great & kettle helms, cloaks, broadswords, shields, and tavern/camp props.

ww2.label: WW2 Frontline
ww2.description: M41 field jackets, officer trenchcoats, M1 steel helmets, field packs, rifles, SMGs, sandbags, and jerrycans.

sim.label: Sim City Life
sim.description: Modern hoodies, tailored blazers, varsity jackets, caps, daypacks, coffee/phones, cafe tables, and benches.

cyberpunk.label: Cyberpunk Neon
cyberpunk.description: High-collar cyber jackets, netrunner rigs, oni helms, AR visors, thermal katanas, smartguns, and neon street kiosks.

monsters.label: Monsters & Beasts
monsters.description: Orc warlords, long-armed trolls, dire wolves on a 23-joint quadruped rig, and giant spiders on a 28-joint arachnid rig.
